https://mastodon.social/@rhys@rhys.wtf/1.text: My #SteamFrame RMA has finally shipped! 🥳 I had a power charging issue that left it unable to boot, and due to a mixup with UPS had its collection delayed by a few days. Then, due to a mixup on their side, it got delayed another few days on its way from the UK to the EU. Then, finally, after yet another mixup on their side in storage, it finally got acknowledged as received and a replacement shipped same day after a final week of delay. Should be back with me this week ☺️ #VR #steam #gaming
